items.title: J. Leo Rayhill interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 23, 2007
items.q: it’s the Basie band under Hughes, it’s very good.

ctx.x: Right. And don’t get hysterical on the air or anything.

No. I’ve been tempted to on occasion but I don’t. I love Basie, he was my favorite. There’s a new CD, brand new, Concord has it out this week. It was recorded in Japan. And it’s the Basie band under Hughes, it’s very good. And they have some wonderful musicians and it’s a good band. Now I do not think that a couple of the other ghost bands really are up to par. They pick up local musicians and try and mend them in, you can’t do it in a couple hours’ rehearsal in a studio, you just can’t do it. But Basie tries to,…
